Model card fetched 200 in the official PurpleLlama repo, content describes the Llama 2 based 7B safeguard model. Paper verified on arXiv (Llama Guard, 200). Llama Guard is Llama 2 based and covered by the Llama 2 Acceptable Use Policy, fetched via WebFetch. No system card for this release.
